permanent_locked_result.raw_output_limit: original per-sample predictions and 24 raw full-chain episodes are unavailable and were not regenerated

additive_dual_body_dynamics.motion_phases: sequential scout motion, then carrier motion; partner parked in each phase
additive_dual_body_dynamics.interpretation_limit: Validates bounded sequential wheel motion by two non-fixed rigid bodies; not a frozen-policy rerun, simultaneous cooperative control, physical-robot result, sim-to-real result, safety certification, throughput, mission-energy, or control-loop-latency benchmark.

compound_contract_progress_challenge.interpretation_limit: Compound intervention attribution only; same-generator, non-locked, not OOD, Genesis/AMD ROCm kinematic simulation, not physical-robot or safety-certification evidence, and does not replace the frozen primary.

simulation_scope.backend: Frozen policy: Genesis 1.1.2 kinematic simulation on AMD ROCm; separate additive supplements: non-fixed rigid-body wheel dynamics
simulation_scope.frozen_policy_agent_realization: carrier and scout are logical-role poses and capture roots on one shared Genesis chassis

additive_decision_bound_dynamics_recover.execution_layout: one fixed seed per fresh Genesis subprocess, serially on one AMD GPU
additive_decision_bound_dynamics_recover.v1_failure_mode: 12-hour outer watchdog exit 124 with no report and no per-seed result
additive_decision_bound_dynamics_recover.observed_execution_ledger: 30 first-attempt worker completions; all worker exit codes 0; no completed-checkpoint rerun or seed replacement observed
proof_scope_limits: The original formal checksum index did not cover ATTEMPTS.jsonl, PROGRESS.json, or worker/execution logs, so it is not cryptographic proof that no additional unsealed attempt ever existed.

The formal source binding omitted the directly imported src/v4_motion.py dependency, so it is not a complete import-closure attestation; a post-run clean-tree audit found matching worktree and commit bytes.
additive_decision_bound_dynamics_recover.interpretation_limit: Consumes archived route decisions without rerunning the frozen perception-policy loop; not simultaneous cooperative control, dynamic-obstacle evidence, physical-robot or sim-to-real validation, throughput, energy, control-loop latency, or safety certification.

additive_decision_bound_dynamics_two_sha.evidence_class: additive non-locked archived-decision rigid-dynamics solver-scale complement
additive_decision_bound_dynamics_two_sha.interpretation_limit: Exactly two independently verified, non-resumable Genesis scene shards with fixed-order serial wheel actuation; 90 cumulative distinct robots, maximum 60 co-resident, never all 90 co-resident. Not a live perception-policy rerun, simultaneous fleet-control result, dynamic-obstacle result, physical-robot or sim-to-real validation, throughput, energy, control-loop latency, or safety certification.
